The municipal planning commission at its regular meeting held on October 31st consider to report from the community services division regarding the discretionary use application for new parking station at 301 Queen Street.
During discussion it was clarified that the parking station will create 11 parking spaces on a very small lot.
The commission expressed concerns that the plan for a parking station would incentivize driving private vehicles and may affect quality of life for surrounding residents.
The applicant explained that the lot was too small for large density uses at this time and the parking station would alleviate some on street parking demand.
Administration indicated that an early version of the plan was considered by the development appeals board.
But the final site plans are found in the administration's report in front of you today.
Any future changes to this use would need to go through the application process for development permit.
The commission is supporting the discretionary use application and respectfully recommend consideration by city council. Thank you.
